title: 第1章 祁澜与杨戬第2章 有三尖两刃刀和黑狗才是正经的杨二郎
content_zh:
雨点淅淅沥沥地拍打在宽阔的树叶上，水珠飞溅在裸露的皮肤上，带来丝丝凉意。
几双草鞋踩过泥泞，迈入一间老旧的棚屋。
“真没天理，这还没下水，就遇上这大雨，好悬没把老汉给冻死！”
一名皮肤黝黑的老汉摘下斗笠，随手把水刺和短戈丢到地上，一屁股坐上棚屋里那块光滑的大石头。
“默老头，你这身子骨虚啊，莫不是被家里婆娘吸干了？”一名年轻汉子咧开大嘴，冲着默老头调笑道。
“去去去，毛头小子懂个屁！”默老头不屑地撇嘴，却不动声色地摸了摸后腰。
另一侧，一名三十来岁的中年汉子默不作声，解开被布盖住的干柴，开始生火。
“嘿，默老头，你这次运气好，”
年轻汉子用肩膀撞了下默老头，嬉笑道，“少君方才可说了，这大鱓若是猎了来，出力的人多分一份，刚好给你补补身子，回家好应付婶子。”
听到能多分一份，默老头顿时喜笑颜开，冲着棚屋角落的一名少年连连作揖：“多谢少君，多谢少君！老汉我打算把这份留给家里那个不成器的臭小子，够他入人境了！”
老汉口中说着“不成器”，语气里却满是得意。
“哦？阿节也要成人境武士了？”说话的少年，唤作祁澜，他坐在木墩子上，笑了笑，“等他入境，是去水寨，还是来我这儿？父亲刚允我编一支卫队，他若过来，倒是正好。”
祁澜身着黑色皮甲，腰间别着铜剑，葛布束发，天庭饱满，眉眼中正。
几人口中的大鱓，其实是一条黄鳝。
不过却是已经成了精怪的黄鳝，被在大泽之岸捕鱼的渔民发现，上报子邦，这才有了祁澜此行。
他是大商王朝西南方长溪部，长溪子爵的世子。
自降生以来，已经十六年了，而解开胎中之谜，觉醒前世记忆，也已经过去了一年有余。
而经过一年多的时间，他也已经摸清了这个世界是怎么一回事。
此时正是大商王朝时期，帝乙在位——这位，便是大名鼎鼎的纣王的父亲。
不过比起正常的古代世界，这儿却明显不正常得多。

虽然大体上还符合这个时代的背景，但却有武道，有练气士，有妖怪，构成了一幅奇异的上古蛮荒世界。
不过练气士，他也只是听说而已，并没有真的见过。
但妖怪是有见过的，比如说即将见到的这只大鱓。
而武道，基本也都是贵族才能修炼的。
最低也得是“士”这一阶层才能接触到。
这具身体在武道上的资质不错，加上掌握着一个子爵邦国的父亲培养与祖上留下的传承，这才以十六岁的年龄，有了人境巅峰的武道修为，能带队出来猎杀这大鱓。
“都说水族蛇鳝，百年而异，五百成蛟，那条大鱓据说是条赤鱓，体表生鳞，头生长须，已然有了异象，此行，还需劳烦二郎助力。”
content_en:
The raindrops pattered on the broad leaves, and the water droplets splashed on the exposed skin, bringing a slight chill.
A few pairs of straw sandals stepped through the mud and entered an old shack.
"It's really unreasonable. We haven't even entered the water yet, but we encountered this heavy rain. I almost froze the old man to death!"
A dark-skinned old man took off his bamboo hat, threw the water spinner and short sword to the ground, and sat down on the big smooth stone in the shack.
"Old man Mo, your body is weak. Could it be that you were sucked dry by your mother-in-law?" A young man grinned widely and said teasingly at old man Mo.
"Go, go, you idiot!" Old Man Mo curled his lips disdainfully, but calmly touched his lower back.
On the other side, a middle-aged man in his thirties silently untied the dry firewood covered with cloth and started to light a fire.
"Hey, old man Mo, you are lucky this time,"
The young man bumped the old man Mo with his shoulder and said with a smile, "Young Master, I just said that if this big bird is hunted, the people who contribute will get an extra share, which will be enough for you to replenish your body so that you can go home and deal with your aunt."
When he heard that he could get an extra share, Old Man Mo immediately beamed with joy and bowed to a young man in the corner of the shack: "Thank you so much, Mr. Master! Thank you so much, Mr. Master! I plan to leave this piece to the incompetent brat at home, it will be enough for him to enter the country!"
The old man said "it's useless", but his tone was full of pride.
"Oh? Ajie is also going to become a warrior in the adult realm?" The young man who spoke, called Qi Lan, sat on the wooden pillar and smiled, "When he enters the country, will he go to the water village or come to my place? Father just allowed me to form a guard. It would be a good time for him to come over."
Qi Lan was dressed in black leather armor, with a bronze sword on his waist. His hair was tied up with Gebu.
What a few people call a giant eel is actually an eel.
However, the eel, which had become a monster, was discovered by fishermen fishing on the shore of Daze and reported to Zibang, which led to Qi Lan's trip.
He was the eldest son of Viscount Changxi of the Changxi tribe in the southwest of the Great Shang Dynasty.
It has been sixteen years since he was born, and more than a year has passed since he solved the mystery of the womb and awakened his past life memories.
And after more than a year, he has figured out what this world is like.
At this time, it was the period of the Great Shang Dynasty, and Emperor Yi was on the throne - this was the father of the famous King Zhou.
But compared to the normal ancient world, this place is obviously much more abnormal.
Although it generally conforms to the background of this era, there are martial arts, spiritual practitioners, and monsters, forming a strange ancient wild world.
However, he had only heard about Qi Practitioners and had never actually seen them.
But monsters have been seen before, such as the big one we are about to see.
As for martial arts, basically only nobles can practice it.
At the lowest level, you have to be a "scholar" to have access to it.
This body has good qualifications in martial arts, coupled with the training from his father who controls a viscount country and the inheritance left by his ancestors, at the age of sixteen, he has the martial arts cultivation at the peak of the human realm, and can lead a team to hunt this big dragon.
"It is said that the snake eels of the aquatic tribe can be transformed into a dragon by a hundred years or more. The big eel is said to be a red eel, with scales on its body and beards growing on its head. It has already had a strange phenomenon. I still need help from Erlang for this trip."
